name: kraken-productivity
description: Three weekday assistants and a one-shot scheduler. Requires Calendar, Email and Drive; no skill runs without them. Daily Brief emails a 2-page PDF at 6 AM: every meeting, real conflicts, and each open ask with a named owner and a verified status. Call Prep books a private prep block before each external call at 4 AM, linking a 1-2 page briefing. Follow-Ups drafts replies in your voice at 4 PM, never sending.
